editorial:
If you love big, colorful sci-fi worlds, this one delivers a wild ride. Valerian and Laureline are space agents in the 28th century, sent to Alpha, a giant space city where aliens from everywhere live together. A dark force threatens the whole place, and the two must figure out what is really going on. The vibe is bright, fast, and packed with strange creatures, cool tech, and nonstop action.

The standout here is the visuals, which look amazing on a big screen, plus some fun action scenes and a playful tone. On the downside, the story can feel thin and the two leads do not always click. Still, it is a fun pick for sci-fi fans and families with older kids. For the best experience, stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray if you want the sharpest picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Valerian and Laureline learn Commander Filitt covered up the destruction of the peaceful planet Mül. The surviving Pearls only want their last energy pearl to rebuild. Valerian hands it over, the Pearls leave in peace, and Filitt is arrested. Laureline finally accepts Valerian's marriage proposal, and the two fly off together.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves big sci-fi worlds and colorful action.
